x_posts.label: Post 3-1
x_posts.text:
Rory McIlroy has won the FedExCup 3 times. No one has ever won 4.

Not Tiger. Not anyone.

He's at East Lake. He's in the field. The record is right there.

#McIlroy #FedExCup #GolfFanrecap

History is one tournament away.

stories.title: LIV Golf's Future — Norman Won't Guarantee 2027 Season

x_posts.label: Post 5-1
x_posts.text:
The 2026 LIV Golf season is over.

Michael La Sasso won the final event. Jon Rahm claimed his 3rd straight individual title. But Greg Norman won't guarantee 2027 is happening.

Ian Poulter is warning LIV is running out of time.

#LIVGolf #GolfFanrecap

x_posts.label: Post 5-2
x_posts.text:
Rahm. La Sasso. 50+ players. One uncertain future.

LIV Golf ended its 2026 season in Indianapolis. The commissioner won't commit to 2027.

What happens to the players who bet their careers on this tour? 👀

#LIVGolf #GolfFanrecap
